editor.mobile.how_link: tap a block, then the target
editor.mobile.how_select: drag a frame with your finger; tap a block to add or remove it
editor.mobile.nothing_hint: Tap a block on the canvas — its title, description, spec and assets will appear here.
editor.mobile.arrow_between: An arrow goes between blocks: tap a block
editor.mobile.arrow_target: Now tap the block the arrow leads to
editor.mobile.link_on: A link goes on a block, group or area: tap one
editor.mobile.group_pick: Tap the blocks to put into a group
editor.mobile.ungroup_pick: Tap a group — its frame or a block inside it
